AI Models & Labs 2026-10-23

📅 Overview · 🤖 AI Agents · 🧠 AI Models & Labs · ⚖️ AI Policy · 🗄️ Data Engineering

Lab posts: 5 | New models: 1 | Spotted: 9 | Generated: 2026-10-22 23:49 UTC

Highlights

  • Anthropic demonstrates LLMs can produce formal proofs at scale, using Claude to verify security properties at the RISC-V assembly level across over 100 open-source libraries and discovering previously undetected bugs.
  • OpenAI models become available on Google Cloud, expanding distribution through a major cloud provider partnership.
  • Recursive releases Flint, a free open-weight mixture-of-experts model with 2.5B active parameters out of 40B total, built by an autoresearch system for coding agents.
  • DeepSeek open-sources DeepInfer, a high-performance large-scale inference framework optimized for its models.
  • Anthropic launches Claude for Google Workspace beta, adding connectors for Docs, Sheets, and Slides.

2026-10-22 Anthropic Open call for guest investigators in the life sciences Anthropic invites principal investigators at academic institutions, nonprofits, or government labs to apply for an 8–12 week collaboration using Claude on research in causal human biology, molecular biology, medicinal chemistry, drug discovery, and clinical science.
2026-10-22 Anthropic Donating Agent Skills to the Agentic AI Foundation Anthropic donates the Agent Skills open standard — a folder-based format giving AI agents specialized knowledge and workflows — to the Agentic AI Foundation under the Linux Foundation for neutral, community-driven governance.
